content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to customize the text displayed on the [product_name] operator device run screen? Currently, it shows the date and time, but I would like to replace it with my company name and some other information when the screen is shown. Thank you in advance.

Yes, you can achieve this by creating a message within your program. Remember to enable the option for the [product_name] operator device or select both, then connect the EN-input accordingly (set it to high or use an inverted open input). Regards, [user_name]
No, it's not possible to go beyond choosing between three available start screens.

Here's further clarification: The [product_name] device shows only the chosen start screen during startup if no user message text exists or none are active. If you create a message text with the lowest priority and keep it constantly enabled, this message will show on startup unless another message text is active. Edit: The same rule applies to the [product_name] operator device screen if you select the appropriate checkbox for it, for both modes and/or the web server during message text configuration.
Thanks everyone, I have it working now! Appreciate the time and help. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users explored how to personalize the display screen of the [product_name] operator device. After some initial doubts about modifying the displayed text, it was clarified that user-created messages and device settings need to be configured. Eventually, the user succeeded in customizing the screen as desired, demonstrating that there is a moderate learning curve related to message configuration and display settings.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to freely personalize the [product_name] operator device run screen, displaying custom information such as their company name instead of default details.
